blocks.text:
By default, PrintOperation::run() returns when a print
operation is completed. If you need to run a non-blocking print operation,
call PrintOperation::set_allow_async(). Note that set_allow_async() is not supported
on all platforms, however the `done` signal will still be emitted.
blocks.zh: 在默认情况下，PrintOperation::run()在打印操作完成时返回。如果你需要运行非阻塞的打印操作，请调用PrintOperation::set_allow_async()。请注意，并非所有平台都支持set_allow_async()，但done信号仍然会被发出。
